name: Emily R.
text: I've lived here for a year now and I absolutely love it! The location is perfect and the views of Columbia are unmatched. The amenities are great and the staff is always so helpful.

name: Tyler B.
text: Overall a great place to live! The proximity to campus is great, although the building is located on Main Street, so the noise can be a little much on weekends.

name: Jordan M.
text: I moved in this August and I really like it here! It's an easy walk to campus and the Vista, and the pool is the perfect spot to hang out with friends on warm days.
